svg.title: Apogee mechanics: icons and emblems
svg.text: A calibrated opponent at your rating, when nobody else is online.
Your set stays planted as an open challenge, and settles when someone answers.
One draw a day, the same for everyone.
A link that opens a duel or a ghost race against you.
Hold a category and band until someone beats your set.
Pick and ban scenarios before the match starts.
Both players at once, every round revealed as it lands.
